## Biography

Doctor Gery serves as Chief Medical Officer aboard the DW3 carrier Odysseus. Known for his dry wit, he once asked Jasmina Halsey to warn him before disappearing into witch-space again. After Halsey's recovery from an ancient escape pod, Gery placed her in medical stasis and reported that her neural signatures were accelerated and unusually focused — the opposite of what would be expected after such an ordeal. He notably declared discussions of Guardian "Caretaker" entities to be "above his pay grade."
